# Stderr of the Cloud `publish` provider on a custody-lane publication run.
# Lines starting with `#` are this header; readers drop them.
#
# Two byte-identical copies of this file exist, one per project that reads it:
#   the CI runner image, at tests/fixtures/provider-publication-stderr.txt
#   this package, at testdata/provider-publication-stderr.txt
# The runner's shell suite checks that they are identical.
#
# Every other line is provider output, in the format
# publication.go writes through credentialServer.diagnose
# (prefix `putnami-cloud credential-provider: `):
#   - open, rerun:              `open: immutable channel ... already has head ...`
#   - release, superseded:      `release: <commit> is not the head of its default branch (its head is <head>); ...`
#   - release, retry:           `release: a forward-only channel moved after it was read; ...`
#   - release, no newer head:   `release: <commit> is not the head ... (Delivery names no newer head); ...`
#   - release, rerun:           `release: immutable channel ... already has head rs_...; this run is a rerun ...`
# plus one line in the retired publication-broker format, which the custody
# lane must ignore.
#
# TestPublicationDiagnosticsMatchTheRunnerFixture (this package) has the
# provider itself write the superseded, retry and no-newer-head lines, and
# compares them with these byte for byte. The two rerun lines follow their
# formats with picked values.
#
# The run's commit (CI_SHA) is aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.
#
# ci-run-native.sh native_note_publication_channel reads only the superseded
# lines that name that commit. Each names its forward-only channels; a channel
# keeps the head of the last line that names it. Expected note:
#   canary already at eeeeeeeeeeee, preview already at eeeeeeeeeeee; no channel moved
putnami-cloud credential-provider: open: immutable channel v3.0.0 already has head rs_ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff; this run is a rerun: it publishes its artifacts and moves no channel
putnami-cloud credential-provider: release: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa is not the head of its default branch (its head is dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd); forward-only channels [canary] stay where they are
putnami-cloud credential-provider: release: a forward-only channel moved after it was read; reading it again
putnami-cloud credential-provider: release: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa is not the head of its default branch (Delivery names no newer head); forward-only channels [canary] stay where they are
putnami-cloud credential-provider: release: immutable channel v3.0.0 already has head rs_ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff; this run is a rerun and channels [latest] stay where they are
publication-broker: stable already at dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd; no channel moved
putnami-cloud credential-provider: release: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa is not the head of its default branch (its head is eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee); forward-only channels [canary preview] stay where they are
